title: Prove hosted machine code routing to the engine
text: Production review on 2026-10-19 proved a fresh four-character code before organization choice, personal approval, matching terminal/browser machine, code and organization, completed credential activation, a fresh authenticated read and consumed onboarding. Durable engine and hosted request consumption matched one newly created active machine credential that was subsequently used. Opening that code in another organization refused with the original organization and fresh-connection recovery; replacing an expired request with a fresh connection also succeeded. These bounded proofs do not establish same-organization replay, lost-delivery recovery, concurrent one-time polling or below-floor operator rollout recovery in production. Those cases retain source/test evidence only. Members controls retire only when the materialized Team contract declares the people destination; production proof of that same predicate on both UI and old site controls remains outstanding. Keep this gap open until all remaining deployed proofs exist; source review and a successful connection do not close it.
